acceptance: Find where phases.validation.status is derived and why it ignores query failures
phases.validation.status cannot be PASSED when any validated query failed, with a test built from a partial throughput run
Decision on whether existing corpus bundles need rechecking
context: Found during the 2026-10-04 throughput adversarial review while checking the SQLite bundle cited by sqlite-throughput-dialect-and-stream-isolation.
description: The SQLite TPC-H SF1 throughput bundle ~/Developer/benchmark_runs/results/tpch_sf1_sqlite_sql_20261003_184424_5702d960.json (develop 061fac04d) has phases.validation.status = "PASSED" while summary.validation = "partial" and summary.queries = {failed: 45, passed: 21, total: 66} (verified from the JSON). Any consumer reading the phase status (corpus gates, explorer, UAT) would treat a failed run as validated.
